selected_scope.title: Universal Interior Viability / Equal Availability
selected_scope.finding: Phases A, B1, B2 and B3 are complete. The authoritative 30 x 53 matrix contains 1,590 cells: 662 VIABLE_EQUAL_100, 14 AUTHOR_OR_OWNER_HARD_BLOCK, 0 CONFIG_GAP, 0 KNOWN_TECHNICAL_RESTRICTION and 914 NOT_YET_PROVEN. The 22 direct LLL Vanilla:100,Custom:100 flows plus Black Mesa's native lethal_company:vanilla/custom rule establish 23 equal-weight interiors on each Vanilla/Custom target moon; exact Offense runtime expands that row to 41 viable plus 12 owner hard blocks. Shatteredrooms x Experimentation and x Embrion are the two additional explicit owner hard blocks. Both External target moons, Black Mesa and Oxyde, remain fully NOT_YET_PROVEN because the broad Vanilla/Custom rules are not extrapolated onto External levels. VIABLE_EQUAL_100 is availability/effective-weight evidence, not generation/traversal compatibility proof.
selected_scope.analysis_contract: Build a current S1.42AK owner/flow/moon viability matrix before authoring any gameplay candidate. Reconcile every registered dungeon flow with its owning system (LLL, JLL, DawnLib/native or other), identify all author/project exclusions and the technical reason for each, and prove that any proposed removal preserves correct entrance/exit pairing, successful generation and traversal, door/socket geometry, elevators, routing and NavMesh behavior. Preserve equal effective rarity 100 for every flow that is viable. Do not duplicate-register native-owner content or bypass an unexplained hard block.
selected_scope.next_action: Phase C: plan and prioritize compatibility proof for the 914 NOT_YET_PROVEN cells and 14 AUTHOR_OR_OWNER_HARD_BLOCK cells. First mine existing repository evidence for entrance/exit pairing, successful generation/traversal, door/socket geometry, elevators/special traversal, routing/NavMesh and duplicate-registration safety so only genuinely unresolved high-risk pairings proceed to targeted runtime proof. No universal override, gameplay build or runtime test is authorized yet.
currently_irrelevant_actions: Do not globally force all dungeon flows onto all moons before the owner/viability matrix identifies why any pairing is currently absent.
Do not modify or replace the accepted S1.42AB InteriorWeightNormalization behavior; it already provides equal effective rarity 100 after viability filtering.
Do not duplicate-register Black Mesa or other DawnLib/JLL/native-owned content through LLL merely to force availability.
Do not remove the Shatteredrooms Experimentation/Embrion restriction until its technical compatibility reason is resolved and tested.

Do not fold CullFactory junkrooms/shatteredrooms exceptions, MelanieMausoleum fog tuning, Black Mesa/Pikmin route recovery, LethalEscapeUpdated, AdditionalNetworking or broad LethalMin repair into this scope.
